title: Add node_modules to .gitignore root level
description:
The root-level node_modules directory was showing up as untracked in git status.

Problem:
- .gitignore only had apps/dashboard/node_modules/ on line 32
- Root-level node_modules/ was not ignored
- This appeared in git status as untracked

Fix:
- Added node_modules/ to .gitignore on line 32 (before apps/dashboard/node_modules/)
- Now both root and subdirectory node_modules are properly ignored

File modified:
- .gitignore:32
creator: Ryan Alyn Porter

custom.beads_close_reason: Completed: Added node_modules/ to .gitignore root level. Git status no longer shows node_modules as untracked.
